Name: Bright vibrant twin braids and crown braids
Author: athalie
Description:
I felt frustrated when I saw I couldn't create a farmer with light ginger/ vivid orange twin braids.
The vanilla twin braids are too dark and the palette doesn't allow a brighter or lighter tone.
That's why I created this hairstyle and wanted to share it thinking it might interest someone else.

[b]The mod adds two new hairstyles (new twin braids different from the vanilla ones and a crown braids) that allow lighter, brighter, more vivid and pastel colors (for this hairstyle only).
